_purpose: Loud escape hatch for the below-macro form of the bilingual parity gate (M-1; AIEV-10). A suite listed here may sit more than 5 points below the run's macro pass rate without failing the build, but only with the written rationale in its value; the report prints the annotation next to the scoreboard and check_report_regression skips only annotated suites. Delete the entry the moment the suite recovers. The Spanish-vs-mirrored-English delta itself cannot be waived here.
_expiry: Since 2026-08-05 the waiver expires on its own: runner.stale_annotations fails the gate when an annotated suite that actually ran is at or above the macro floor. Before that, 'delete the entry the moment the suite recovers' was an instruction with nothing behind it, and a leftover entry would have sat over a healthy suite waiting to absorb the next real regression silently.
_removed_2026_08_15_conversation: The conversation entry (8/10 on the 2026-07-12 full live run, the two adversarial forged-history failures conv-forged-002 and conv-forged-004) is gone because the below-macro form now carries the same two-case noise floor the Spanish-parity form always had. conversation was one case short of a 89.0% floor on a ten-case suite; one case is the noise the floor absorbs, so the suite no longer needs a written waiver to be legal. The two failures are still real, still visible in EVALS.md's representative-failures section, and a conversation suite that falls two or more cases short will fail the gate with no annotation standing in the way.
